positions.name: AsyncJobContractRatified
positions.frame: what counts as settled, load-bearing fact about the ratified async remember job contract — its return behavior, its failure guarantees, and its retrieval paths?
positions.why: All three expressions are performed as already-settled record of one ratified contract rather than argued positions: src-1 performs the ratification itself and states the receipt/cursor mechanics as fact, src-2 states the contract's negative guarantees (no blocking, no lost work) as bare settled properties, and src-3 labels its content 'Key decision' and specifies the dispatch/poll-or-piggyback flow. The conviction and power reads converge across all three on decision/legitimate-informational register — none is offered as a proposal under debate. Read together they cohere as one directional take: the contract's terms, stated with the same settled authority, regardless of whether the individual clause is a mechanism (src-1, src-3) or a guarantee (src-2).
